title: Opposite category
description: JSON Schema for an opposite category C^op — the category with the same objects as C and with arrows reversed (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. II §2; Awodey 2010 §1.3). Specializes category by carrying a single base-category cell — the C whose arrows are being reversed. Used to type contravariant functors as covariant functors from C^op.

base-category.description: The base category C whose opposite this is. Ob(C^op) = Ob(C); for every f : A → B in C, there is f^op : B → A in C^op. Composition in C^op is composition in C reversed: g^op ∘^op f^op = (f ∘ g)^op.
